facts.fact: 拍卖品 Lot 5 是一张手绘的 Rushwood（威尔特郡 Wiltshire）地图，绘于 1969 年，材质为 A2 卡纸上的墨线笔与水彩（ink pen and watercolour on A2 card）。
facts.anchor: Lot 5: Hand-drawn map of Rushwood, Wiltshire, 1969. Ink pen and watercolour on A2 card.

facts.fact: Mimi 熟悉挂在门厅（entrance hall）的那幅带框、六英尺高的 Rushwood 房舍与庭园大图——透过大窗可见、夜间有照明——并注意到它遗漏了劳作区域（working areas）；她的版本顽皮地补上了这一失衡，加绘了园丁头的小屋（head gardener's cottage，箭头标注 'Unfortunately, you are here'）、室外厕所（outdoor privy）、洗衣房、厨子的后厨（cook's back kitchen）、棕榈温室（palm house）等花园建筑，乃至堆肥堆（compost heaps）。
facts.anchor: had noted its omission of the working areas. Her version mischievously redressed this balance

facts.fact: 地图地面上散布的 X 标记在图例（key）中有说明，其中有 'The Saving' 与 'Beware – Harold roams here'。
facts.anchor: explained in the key, among them ‘The Saving’ and ‘Beware – Harold roams here’

facts.fact: Mimi 的拼写错误 'unfortutly'（原文标 [sic]）由她的姐姐 Pamela 修正；Pamela 还在图右下角留下一枚沾泥的指印。
facts.anchor: was corrected by her sister Pamela, who also left a muddy fingerprint at the bottom right

facts.fact: Pamela 因怕这张地图会给她们惹上麻烦，试图抢下并毁掉它，但 Mimi 紧抓不放（held fast），地图得以保住。
facts.anchor: Fearing the map might get them into trouble, Pamela tried to snatch it and destroy it, but Mimi held fast.

relations.evidence: was corrected by her sister Pamela
